note: Small private campground on the east edge of Waterville along the Big Paint Creek trout stream, firepits at the sites. Near Yellow River State Forest and Effigy Mounds. --Claude
summary: Own site confirms 50/30/20A full hookups, wifi, FCFS with prepay, $35 tax included, April-October. Note's Apr 15-Oct 15 dropped as contradicted. Waterfront lead up to creekside; long-stay evidence reported.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, UP: riverview -> creekside. z19 imagery: the row of rigs on the south side sits ~15-20 m from Big Paint Creek over open grass with no road or day use between; the road runs on the far side of them. Creek about 8 m wide, well under 30 m, so creekside not riverfront; 'riverview' has no footing at that width anyway. Campers agree: RV Life 2016 'All but two back up to Paint Creek', 2012 'all of the sites back up to a trout stream', Google 6 years ago 'the stream right behind us'. Operator's own wording is only 'on the scenic Big Paint Trout Stream'.

LONG-STAY, on the fence, your call: the site sells $35 a day, $190/7, $580/30 and $1,475 a season. Test 2 passes (posted nightly rate). Test 3 passes (no minimum stated). Test 5 passes (RV sites, no home community). TEST 4 is the doubt: RV Life 2022-07-15 'This is a very small RV park, approximately 12 sites. Most are taken up by full-timers. However, most of them rarely show up, so in reality, it's more of a storage facility. I only saw three other'...; RV Life 2026-07-30 'Stayed here for two months while we visited family... offered monthly rates'; Google 8 years ago 'our home away from home'. Against that, RV Life 2018-08-25 'We had the entire campground to ourselves that weekend'. Imagery shows a row of parked rigs, about 6-8. Ratings aren't iffy: Google 4.6 on 16, RV Life 5.0 on 5, so no auto-drop.

PRIVATE GATE: rate $35 posted, tax included, 2026 site (Copyright 2026, page uploads 2025). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Wisconsin Dells 132 km), not needed. Presence: own website with phone 319-330-2903 and address 75 East Main St. Google 4.6 on 16 is under 25 reviews, doesn't matter with a website. Price: posted, RV Life $$.

PHONE: Google still shows 563-535-7256 for 'Pine Bluff Camp Sites LLC'; the operator's site says 319-330-2903, matching stored. Owner seems to have changed (reviews: Jim McShane until ~2020; 2026 'The owner, John').
